features: INTRODUCTION TO KOBO LIBRA COLOUR CASE: This protective case is designed specifically for the Kobo Libra Colour 7-inch ereader, providing a secure and stylish cover that enhances both convenience and durability. With its slim profile and thoughtful features, it keeps your device protected while making daily reading and travel more comfortable and efficient.

PREMIUM PU LEATHER PROTECTION: Crafted from high-quality PU leather, this case delivers reliable defense against scratches, bumps, and everyday wear. The smooth exterior feels comfortable in hand while maintaining a refined appearance, ensuring your ereader stays protected without adding unnecessary bulk to your device.

BUILT IN KICKSTAND DESIGN: The integrated kickstand allows you to enjoy hands-free reading at your preferred angle. Whether at home, in a cafe, or during travel, the stand provides stable support for long reading sessions, improving comfort and reducing the need to hold your device for extended periods.

AUTO WAKE AND SLEEP FUNCTION: This smart cover includes an auto-wake feature that activates your Kobo Libra Colour when opened and returns it to sleep mode when closed. This convenience saves battery life, streamlines your reading experience, and ensures your ereader is always ready when you are.

HAND GRIP CARD POCKET AND PEN HOLDER: Designed for ultimate convenience, the case features a secure hand grip for comfortable one handed reading. The built in card pocket offers space for small essentials, while the pen holder keeps your stylus or pen accessible at all times, making this case practical for daily use.
